items.title: GE Vernova secures Stage 3 contract for Queensland Supernode battery project
items.summary: GE Vernova (NYSE:GEV) has been selected by Quinbrook to provide technology for the third stage of the Supernode Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) development in Queensland, Australia, further extending its involvement in the large-scale energy storage project. Under the latest contract, GE Vernova will supply power conversion technology, plant controls, system integration services and grid-connection support.

items.summary: A number of stocks fell in the morning session after the latest industrial production report showed slower-than-expected growth for July.
